top_reforms.reform: Wassenaar Agreement legacy & wage moderation framework (2010s)
top_reforms.description: Building on 1982 Wassenaar, tripartite wage restraint agreements kept unit labour costs competitive; reinforced during sovereign debt crisis.
top_reforms.outcome: Netherlands avoided severe competitiveness losses; maintained current account surplus; export growth.

top_reforms.description: Replaced state insurance monopoly with regulated private competition; mandatory universal basic insurance; risk-equalisation fund.
top_reforms.outcome: Universal coverage achieved; cost-efficiency improved; widely cited as model for market-based universal healthcare.

top_reforms.description: Tightening of mortgage interest deduction; introduction of social housing means-testing; gradual pension age increase to 67.
top_reforms.outcome: Housing market stabilised after bubble; pension sustainability improved; fiscal consolidation achieved.
